nodes.title: E4 Kila: turn-based tower defence over the periodicity law (a tower on square p fires on p, 2p, 3p…; the wave moves only on next / run). Modes multiples (mark / guard / common), factors (all), lcm (meet); budget = answers + 2 so 'build everything' cannot win. New law topics: c4-maths-ch03-t01, c5-maths-ch13-t01, c5-maths-ch13-t02. Why: factors/multiples was the largest maths gap served only by ITEM-ARENA. Reverse: a child pilot shows the tower frame hides the factor/multiple distinction.

naksha (maps and grids) as one law family for SST lat/long and the maths grid/route/scale topics: locate (drone to a lat/long crossing), route (steps / compass with a rotated north / turns relative to heading), scale (fuel for road cm x scale; where D km runs out), shape (fence a copy on a dot plot; a turn counts, a flip does not). 5 topics: c6-sst-ch01-t01, c4-maths-ch01-t03, c4-maths-ch02-t02, c5-maths-ch14-t01, c5-maths-ch14-t02. Why: one mechanic serves the only class 4-7 SST grid topic and four uncovered maths topics. Reverse: the kits' grid skills split into mechanics that do not share a board.

Yantra 3D renders all three laws (beam, circuit, pendulum) from one engine entry, dispatching by mode: circuit as a workbench of brass posts (current beads follow the law's loop; a spark plus the law's reason otherwise), pendulum as a lab stand with four bobs of visibly different mass and a beat bell (the law's own period, no formula). Why: one engine keeps the theme pack and certification in one place. Reverse: a mid-range Android cannot hold the three scenes in one chunk.

A play piece keeps its whole box (>= MIN_BOX 300x440) under the teacher's PiP; StudioStage names the covered bottom-right corner on .st-box (data-pip-keep, --pip-keep-w/h) and PlayStage reads it live, the controls reserving that corner (right padding + min-height). Why: 6e1036a37's lift/fit handed play 263x432 at p360 and every game fell back to its text twin. Reverse: the PiP moves out of the slot on phones.

A play certificate certifies the GAME: play-cert judges each size on its own, records the box and whether the play stage mounted, and fails twin:layout / twin:no-stage; tests/r7-games-cert-twin.test.mjs holds it. play-cert checkpoints after every coverage entry and --resume skips entries already judged in this format (container restarts lost whole families). Why: the p360 twin passed as the game after 6e1036a37. Reverse: never; a twin that passes as a game is a silent lie.

Play recertification on integration 4/5 (PiP fix), forge3-qa@2 at p360 / p412 / l1366, seeds 2, every art and 3D theme: 2928 samples, each recording box and game=true; 2928/2928 pass at every size after three view fixes. Per family: naksha 72, todo-jodo 152, taraazu 64, nishana 212, kyun-lab 144, kaal 88, kila 72, kon 80, nazariya 224, stambh 56, vakya 48, yantra 84, arena 1632. p360 box 320x524, p412 372x639, l1366 720x520.

Judged as the real game on a phone box, three views clipped their rail (goal + readouts share one line, readouts capped at 52%, goal clamped to 2 lines): taraazu weigh/fill (p360 and p412), todo-jodo atoms hcf/lcm (p360; pre-existing, 20/32 samples), vakya rail (p360, the kit prompt). Fixed per family: the goal takes the full width and readouts wrap below; vakya's goal may take 4 lines; taraazu dropped its live tilt sentence (the beam shows it). The twin had hidden all three.

md.decisions:
### Round 7 Games (C2), 2026-11-04/05

- **E4 Kila** (factors, multiples, LCM) and **naksha** (maps and grids: lat/long, routes, compass, scale, grid shapes) are law families. Together they add 8 class 4-7 topics: 3 for Kila and 5 for naksha, one of them SST.
- **Yantra 3D** renders beam, circuit and pendulum from one engine.
- **Play under the PiP:** a play box keeps its whole size under the teacher's PiP. The PiP corner is a keep-out zone that PlayStage reads live from `.st-box` (Studio 4583e85c, Games 8b347c051).
- **Certification certifies the game.** play-cert records the box and the mounted view per size and fails a twin (`twin:layout` / `twin:no-stage`). It checkpoints after each coverage entry and resumes with `--resume`.
md.measurements:
### Play recertification, 2026-11-05 (forge3-qa@2, p360/p412/l1366)

- **Total:** 2928 samples; every one records its box and `game: true`.
- **Pass rate:** 2928/2928 pass at every size, after three rail fixes (taraazu weigh/fill, todo-jodo atoms hcf/lcm, vakya).
- **Boxes:** p360 320x524, p412 372x639, l1366 720x520.
- **Samples per family:** naksha 72, todo-jodo 152, taraazu 64, nishana 212, kyun-lab 144, kaal 88, kila 72, kon 80, nazariya 224, stambh 56, vakya 48, yantra 84, arena 1632.
- **Needs a live phone check:** the PiP keep-corner reservation. The harness has no PiP.
